rows.question: What is the damage refund window?
rows.answer:
Items that arrive damaged or broken can be refunded in full within 7 days of delivery. Send a clear photo of the damage and the packaging to support. A refund is issued to the original payment method within 5 business days after the photo is approved.

Source: Refund > Damage refund (Returns_Policy)

rows.question: How long do I have to return an item I changed my mind about?
rows.answer:
Change of mind returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery. A 15% restocking fee is deducted from the refund. Items must be unused and in the original packaging.

Source: Refund > Change of mind refund (Returns_Policy)

rows.answer:
